sectionSubtitle: How I safeguard sensitive information, handle access credentials, and maintain async operational momentum.

principles.title: Credential Sanitization
principles.description: Zero plain-text password sharing. I interface exclusively through encrypted password managers (1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass) and environment variables for Apps Script integrations.

principles.title: Defensive Data Architecture
principles.description: All spreadsheet systems and databases are engineered with strict role-based view/edit permissions, protected formula ranges, and automated version-history checkpoints to prevent accidental data overwrites.

principles.title: Contractual Discretion
principles.description: Ready to execute standard Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) before auditing your internal workflows, client lists, financial sheets, or proprietary operational documents.

principles.title: Structured Communication
principles.description: Daily async status updates via Slack or Notion, paired with weekly end-of-week video recaps. No unnecessary meeting overhead; clear milestones, predictable turnarounds, and proactive escalation.

reassurance: Trust is the prerequisite for high-leverage delegation. I treat your operational data with the same defensive standards as an enterprise engineering system.
